neighbours.label: the slot just before a famous historical figure is named (conquered by, thinkers such as, as feared as), on the preceding function word; the same frames before ordinary people or things stay quiet
fire: Students of the ancient empires read about the lands ruled by Genghis Khan.
She lectured on early scientists such as Galileo and Copernicus.
Few generals in history were as admired as Napoleon Bonaparte.
Many revolutions of that century were shaped by the writings of Karl Marx.
The museum shows letters written by great statesmen such as Abraham Lincoln.
Medieval scholars endlessly debated the ideas of Aristotle.
The play follows the legendary rulers of Egypt, such as Cleopatra.
His theories of the mind were first challenged by followers of Sigmund Freud.
quiet: Students of the local schools read about the farms owned by my uncle.
She lectured on kitchen appliances such as toasters and blenders.
Few neighbors in our building were as friendly as Mr. Daniels.
Many complaints of that winter were caused by the heating of the office.
The shop sells cards written by local children such as my niece.
Weekend gardeners endlessly debated the price of tomatoes.
The bus follows the main roads of town, such as Elm Street.
His plans for the deck were first changed by the owner of the store.

short: slot before naming a famous historical figure
notes: Card: ' of', ' to', ' by', ' and', ' as' before names; output promotes Marx, Freud, Newton, Darwin, Aristotle, Plato, Hamilton.
